invariants.rationale: If the TextField is disabled, the method returns false, otherwise result may be true.
When the TextField is disabled, keyTyped always returns false, so if result is true then !disabled must hold.

invariants.expression: (character != BACKSPACE && character != TAB && character != NEWLINE && character != CARRIAGE_RETURN && character < 32) ? !result : true
invariants.rationale: If the character is a control character not in the switch-case, the method returns false.
If the TextField does not have keyboard focus, the method returns false.
If there is a filter and it does not accept the character (and it's not enter), the method must return true (early return), otherwise result could be true.
